As for Ceylon, the girls, sitting in a tributary canoe in the middle of a coconut bowl, listening to sweet music by the honey tea cup, stopped by the coconut candies to see the person who pulls the sweets that are still hot – the scent is long remembered.
Early the next morning, the whole crew head to the edge of the edge of the teeth – hearing the engine boom, watching the tree hang up, having a good day on the river. It's a very "President morning".
And there can't be any shortage of the Color House – where the competitions are shaped, laughing, the camera is never out of its good corners.
TodayTourist thanks KP29 – GE Long Ping Trusted Associated. Thank you for bringing with you the spirit of joy, so binding – exactly as the name "The Faith".
Thank you, HDV Tianjin, for taking care of the crew all the way.
Ladies, drop your heart and comment the moment you remember the most on this trip!
